notes.title: Introducing Puppet Project
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is Benjamín from Puppeteers Devs, the team behind this upcoming horror game!

From now on, we'll be using this Steam section more frequently to share devlogs and updates. We believe it's a good time to start posting, as the game's release is relatively close.

[h2]🎭 Introducing Puppet Project![/h2]

Puppet Project is a horror game set in the eerie facilities of Canal 7, where you’re stuck with a disturbing puppet clinging to your arm. Your goal? Find a way to get rid of it… before something much worse happens.

The game is inspired by Chilean television: from news programs to peculiar broadcasts from public TV, like 31 Minutos. Puppet Project is an original horror story, based on a wide range of local references and Chilean television culture.

[h2]🛠️ Development Status[/h2]

We're making great progress and have big plans for this year:

[list]
[*] A demo release  
[*] Community playtesting  
[*] And if all goes well… a full release before the end of the year!
[/list]

As a small indie team, we can’t promise fixed dates just yet, but we’re working hard to make it happen.

[h2]🙌 Thanks for Your Support[/h2]

Thanks so much to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist. And if you haven’t done it yet, now’s a great time to show your support ;).

See you soon with more updates!

[b]- Puppeteers Devs[/b]
